extraction.Name: Mrs. Ramona Glick Jenkins
extraction.Refused/Protested: sale was made with her full knowledge and consent and that she was entirely satisfied with sale
extraction.Buyer: sold to A. E. Granger, address: Kadoka, South Dakota, in 1920, consideration for sale being Twenty-five Hundred ($2500.00) Dollars for one hundred sixty (160) acres
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the land was not sold for debt or taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband is supporting her in a satisfactory manner
extraction.NOTES: land was taken by her father for the benefit of his minor children; father's name being T. W. Glick; deponent received cash for sale; she is in good mental, physical, and financial condition; has no dependents upon her for support; she was not defrauded of her property; document dated 1927
